## more.slot Test 6

This update brings the select.slot handheld features into the separate UnsloT-based more.slot build while retaining its Game Gear support.

- Adds the Authentic display pipeline to GB, GBC, GBA, and Game Gear, with color correction kept as an independent setting.
- Adds one-press Shift and double-press Caps Lock behavior to the on-screen keyboard.
- Retains PicoDrive Game Gear support, the dedicated Game Gear LCD effect, separate bezel and cartridge art, German UI, and the more.slot test-only OTA channel.

This is a test release for the RG35XX H target. It does not change the stable select.slot release or its update feed.
